# Zenn

> > Japanese technical knowledge-sharing platform featuring developer articles on cloud infrastructure, AI-assisted development, and modern web technologies.

Zenn is a developer community platform where engineers share tutorials, guides, and technical insights primarily in Japanese. Content spans cloud services (Azure, Vercel, Netlify), AI development tools (Cursor, PyTorch), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, TypeScript).

## Key Topics

- AI-assisted development
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- Cloud platforms (Azure, Vercel, Netlify)
- React and Next.js
- TypeScript
- GitHub and VS Code
- Cursor AI
- Free hosting services
- Serverless deployment
- PyTorch and TTS
- Terraform and Pulumi
- Vulnerability scanning
- Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
- GraphQL and API development
- CSS and Tailwind
